Tencent QQ penguin — local prototype asset

Public source page: https://im.qq.com/index
Original asset URL (linked as favicon by the official website):
https://static-res.qq.com/static-res/imqq/qq-logo.png
Retrieved: 2026-10-23
The downloaded 64 x 64 PNG is used without alteration. Copyright and trademark
rights remain with Tencent. This is not a claim of endorsement or a license.

Official visual identity reference:
https://isux.tencent.com/wp-content/uploads/2016/05/20160512101222609.pdf
QQ Brand Book, Tencent ISUX, 2016; symbol and image-specification sections.

Historical prototype treatment (retained for reference/rollback, not the current
3D companion): the original artwork perches above a ticket and moves by
translation only on greeting or reward unlock. It is not an official sitting-pose
asset. Surrounding sparkles and UI animations are original prototype interactions,
not Tencent-provided animation material. For production, obtain the approved IP
character/animation pack and usage clearance rather than enlarging this favicon.

Current concept artwork is recorded separately in
design/qq-companion-3d-prompts.txt. It is AI-generated proposal material, not an
official Tencent 3D character or animation pack.
